scope: Wallpaper export preview with share and confirmed Photos save
Separate light/dark presets for gradients, photos and solid backgrounds
Hide and suspend remote refresh for local backgrounds
Adapt home title, group controls, menu, search field and suggestions to background contrast
unit_coverage: Persisted appearance presets and legacy fallbacks
Original photo bytes retained separately for each appearance
Cancelled and invalid selections cannot overwrite an original
Editing the inactive appearance leaves the displayed photo intact
Local sources cannot restart remote refresh or switch to remote sources
Export snapshot keeps original bytes after the wallpaper changes
Permission failure is not reported as save success; retry and duplicate-save guards
Image-based contrast and saturated solid colors
Cloud settings and portable backup regressions

ui_checks.iphone_ipad: iOS/iPadOS 26.2: preview, confirmed Photos save, native image share sheet with original PNG caption, light/dark editor selection, local sources without remote refresh settings
ui_checks.contrast_matrix: White and dark-blue backgrounds in both app appearances; dark photo in light app appearance. Reviewed exported screenshots.
ui_checks.ios16: iOS 16.0: app installation, launch and screenshots for a dark background in light appearance and a white background in dark appearance. Smoke checks only; UI test runner target is iOS 16.4.

network: QA used local image fixtures and URLProtocol mocks. No live Pexels/Pixabay API calls or paid services.
